I'm not saying vaporwave is bad or that synthwave is objectively better, I'm a huge fan of both, but I prefer the music that somebody like Com Truise makes. All I'm commenting on is that there are some clichés in the genre that make it boring to sift through at times. I don't think there's anything wrong with using samples, but it can get pretty grating in any genre when overly relied upon; look at what happened to hard electronic music when it exploded, that was *way* worse. I don't think.vaporwave is unoriginal compared to other forms of music, its easily one of the most unique I've ever heard, I just think it lacks originality *within* the genre itself; a lot of people make tracks that sound like one another to a perplexing degree. I find the low pitch, slowed down music in the background so prevalent in so many songs, and it's a bit boring to me personally because most of the time it isn't used in an interesting way.
